# noVNC dependency

Unmodified `core/` and `vendor/` from noVNC v1.7.0, commit
`63107bd06d9e1f6136ff21aeda8cd62cbf0d433e`.
Source: https://github.com/novnc/noVNC/tree/v1.7.0

Oak serves these local ES modules without a CDN or runtime package download.
Upstream copyright notices, authors and license files are retained. See
`LICENSE.txt` and the per-file notices for MPL-2.0, BSD and bundled dependencies.
Only the library is included; Oak owns the surrounding control-panel UI.
